name: analytics-history-tablet
goal: Keep loop history labels readable at tablet widths

evidence: At tablet width the eight narrow table columns split headers and model names inside words. Labeled rows keep each field readable.
The prior catalog assertion covered horizontal fit and mobile labels but did not exercise the tablet layout. The same label check now covers compact tablet width.
The committed tablet catalog assertion failed on harbor-mbp-2 because the compact field labels are not displayed at tablet width.
Use the labeled stacked history rows at tablet widths and keep the status badge at its natural width.
The unchanged tablet catalog assertion passed on harbor-mbp-2 at the repair commit.
